confirm.createApiTokenBody:
Create a new API access token?

The full token is shown only once.
confirm.deleteAccountStep1Body:
Permanently delete your account?

This cannot be undone. It removes:
• All hosts, credentials, groups, and tags you created
• Hosts you shared (revoked for others; their related chats, knowledge, prompts, tags, and channels for those hosts are also removed)
• All your AI sessions and messages, API tokens, mail settings, trigger jobs, scheduled jobs, and batch operations
• All files in your web/fs workspace

Continue?
confirm.trialResetBody: Reset the shared Key call count for “{{user}}”? They can use the shared Key up to {{limit}} more times afterward.
confirm.trialUnlockTitle: Apply system AI config to user
confirm.trialUnlockBody:
Write the default system AI config to “{{user}}”?

This copies Key / URL / Model to their user_ai_config. They will use their own quota, not the shared Key limit.
confirm.clearOpLogsBody: Delete all operation logs? This cannot be undone.
confirm.clearAllBatchBody: Delete all batch job records? This cannot be undone.
confirm.clearSearchConfig: Clear all settings (including API Key) for {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
confirm.suspendUser: Suspend “{{name}}”? They cannot sign in until an admin restores the account.
confirm.deleteUser: Delete “{{name}}” and all of their data? This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteCron: Delete this scheduled job and all run history and session records? This cannot be undone.
confirm.clearScheduledRunHistory:
Clear all run history and session records for this scheduled job?

Runs currently in progress (status=running) are not removed. The scheduled job itself stays.
This cannot be undone.
confirm.clearTriggeredRunHistory:
Clear all finished run history (completed / failed) and session records for this triggered task?

Incomplete runs (e.g. pending) are kept. The triggered task itself stays.
This cannot be undone.
confirm.recallFeedback: Recall feedback #{{id}}? This cannot be undone.
confirm.recallReplyPhysical: Delete this reply permanently? If this feedback has no replies left, its status reverts to open.
confirm.deleteMessageThread: Delete message #{{id}} and all replies? This cannot be undone.
